Public providers of the applications and packs godot_pack and godot_app build.

Read them in a consuming rule's implementation after declaring a provider constraint on
the input attribute, for example to deploy a pack or a desktop application.

Example:
```starlark
load("@autoload_rules_godot//godot:providers.bzl", "GodotPackInfo")

def _consume_impl(ctx):
    pack = ctx.attr.pack[GodotPackInfo]
    return [DefaultInfo(files = depset([pack.pack_file]))]

consume_pack = rule(
    implementation = _consume_impl,
    attrs = {"pack": attr.label(providers = [GodotPackInfo])},
)
```

<a id="GodotDesktopAppInfo"></a>

## GodotDesktopAppInfo

<pre>
load("@autoload_rules_godot//godot:providers.bzl", "GodotDesktopAppInfo")

GodotDesktopAppInfo(<a href="#GodotDesktopAppInfo-bundle">bundle</a>, <a href="#GodotDesktopAppInfo-archive">archive</a>, <a href="#GodotDesktopAppInfo-operating_system">operating_system</a>, <a href="#GodotDesktopAppInfo-executable_path">executable_path</a>, <a href="#GodotDesktopAppInfo-runtime_component">runtime_component</a>)
</pre>

Selected desktop application bundle and distributable archive.

Produced by godot_app on desktops; macOS fields refer to the unsigned or signed
bundle the macos_signing setting selects. executable_path stays relative to that
bundle.
In a consuming rule implementation, read `ctx.attr.app[GodotDesktopAppInfo].archive`
to obtain the distributable File. The bundle field contains the application
tree artifact; executable_path locates the runtime executable inside it.

**FIELDS**

| Name  | Description |
| :------------- | :------------- |
| <a id="GodotDesktopAppInfo-bundle"></a>bundle |  File: tree artifact containing the application directory.    |
| <a id="GodotDesktopAppInfo-archive"></a>archive |  File: deterministic ZIP (macos) or tar.gz (linux) distribution archive.    |
| <a id="GodotDesktopAppInfo-operating_system"></a>operating_system |  string: linux or macos.    |
| <a id="GodotDesktopAppInfo-executable_path"></a>executable_path |  string: POSIX executable path relative to the bundle root.    |
| <a id="GodotDesktopAppInfo-runtime_component"></a>runtime_component |  provenance of the runtime component packaged in the bundle, with the fields of editor_component of GodotPackInfo, or None for an opaque runtime    |

## GodotPackInfo

<pre>
load("@autoload_rules_godot//godot:providers.bzl", "GodotPackInfo")

GodotPackInfo(<a href="#GodotPackInfo-pack_file">pack_file</a>, <a href="#GodotPackInfo-pack_files">pack_files</a>, <a href="#GodotPackInfo-project">project</a>, <a href="#GodotPackInfo-operating_system">operating_system</a>, <a href="#GodotPackInfo-cpus">cpus</a>, <a href="#GodotPackInfo-environment">environment</a>, <a href="#GodotPackInfo-available">available</a>,
              <a href="#GodotPackInfo-export_options">export_options</a>, <a href="#GodotPackInfo-facts">facts</a>, <a href="#GodotPackInfo-version">version</a>, <a href="#GodotPackInfo-editor_component">editor_component</a>, <a href="#GodotPackInfo-variant">variant</a>, <a href="#GodotPackInfo-icons">icons</a>, <a href="#GodotPackInfo-splash">splash</a>)
</pre>

A Godot-exported PCK and its declared project. Produced by godot_pack; consumed by run/test rules and application rules.

**FIELDS**

| Name  | Description |
| :------------- | :------------- |
| <a id="GodotPackInfo-pack_file"></a>pack_file |  File: exported .pck with extension descriptors but no extension libraries    |
| <a id="GodotPackInfo-pack_files"></a>pack_files |  depset[File] of PCK outputs    |
| <a id="GodotPackInfo-project"></a>project |  what the pack delivers in the current platform slice: member_resource_paths, which include the project's context files, runtime_extensions, export_extensions, platform_libraries and infoplists; common content is exported separately    |
| <a id="GodotPackInfo-operating_system"></a>operating_system |  string: the operating system the pack is exported for: linux, macos, android or ios    |
| <a id="GodotPackInfo-cpus"></a>cpus |  list[string]: canonical full requested CPU set    |
| <a id="GodotPackInfo-environment"></a>environment |  string: device or simulator for iOS, otherwise empty    |
| <a id="GodotPackInfo-available"></a>available |  depset of JSON Files {pack, resources} of this pack and every pack it requires; resources maps each contained path to its source path    |
| <a id="GodotPackInfo-export_options"></a>export_options |  dict[string, string] of the export preset options the pack sets, as Godot literals    |
| <a id="GodotPackInfo-facts"></a>facts |  File: JSON of what Godot decides for the pack's export, which application rules write their shell files from: features, the export's feature tags; options, every export option of the operating system with its value or default; settings, the project settings with the export's feature overrides; versions, the values of the version options as Godot's exporter reads them; name_translations, the project's name by locale of its translations    |
| <a id="GodotPackInfo-version"></a>version |  string: canonical version of the editor that exported the pack; diagnostic only, never compared with the runtime    |
| <a id="GodotPackInfo-editor_component"></a>editor_component |  provenance of the editor component that exported the pack: label (component), kind, version, origin, digest and customizations    |
| <a id="GodotPackInfo-variant"></a>variant |  string: release or debug, the template variant of the export and of the runtime it needs; debug in the editor variant    |
| <a id="GodotPackInfo-icons"></a>icons |  list[File] of the application icons Godot renders for the pack's operating system, which only applications using them build: for Android a resource directory with the launcher icons, for iOS an asset catalog with the AppIcon set, for macOS a directory with icon.icns; empty for other operating systems    |
| <a id="GodotPackInfo-splash"></a>splash |  list[File] of the splash images Godot renders for the pack's operating system: for Android a resource directory with the splash screen's drawables, for iOS an asset catalog with the launch screen's SplashImage, Godot's boot splash unless the project sets one; empty for other operating systems    |
